name: Sortivo Tabs Organizer
author: mbenneke

sections.description:
The Plugins page is one long list. Sortivo Tabs Organizer splits it into tabs like SEO, Security, Speed & Cache, Backup, Forms, Shop and more.

  • Automatic sorting – every plugin lands in the right tab the moment you activate Sortivo Tabs Organizer.
  • Move any plugin – a small “Tab” picker under each plugin lets you put it somewhere else, or back on Auto.
  • Your own tabs – make tabs like “Client X” or “To remove”.
  • Remembers your tab – after activating, deactivating or searching you stay in the tab you were in.
  • Tidy sidebar – the menu items plugins add to the left sidebar are grouped under the same tab names, with a collapsible header per group. No page is moved and no link changes, so every plugin keeps working. Turn it off with one checkbox on the Plugins page.
  • Export / import – download your layout as a file (Tools > Sortivo Tabs) and import it on other sites, or use WP-CLI: wp sortivo export and wp sortivo import.
  • Works with the All / Active / Inactive / Update filters and with search.

Sortivo Tabs Organizer does not send any data anywhere. Your layout is stored in your own database.
sections.installation:
1. In your dashboard, go to Plugins > Add Plugin and search for “Sortivo Tabs Organizer”, or upload the zip file there.
  2. Activate it. The tabs appear on the Plugins page right away.
  3. Optional: move plugins to another tab with the “Tab” picker, or click “+ New tab” to make your own.
sections.faq:
Does it change or move my plugins?

No. It only changes how the Plugins list and the admin sidebar are shown. Plugins are not moved, renamed or changed. Deactivate Sortivo Tabs Organizer and everything looks exactly as before.

How does it decide which tab a plugin goes in?

Well-known plugins are recognised by their slug. Others are sorted by keywords in their name and description. If a plugin lands in the wrong tab, pick another tab under that plugin and it stays there.

Can I turn off the sidebar grouping?

Yes. Untick “Group the sidebar menu too” at the top of the Plugins page.

Can I use the same tabs on all my sites?

Yes. Go to Tools > Sortivo Tabs, download the export file and import it on your other sites. Plugins that are not installed there yet get their tab as soon as you install them. With WP-CLI: wp sortivo export > layout.json and wp sortivo import layout.json.

Does it work on multisite?

Multisite has not been tested yet, so it is not officially supported for now.
sections.changelog:
0.6.1

  • First public release on WordPress.org.
  • Fix: a sidebar group now folds away completely, also when another plugin (such as WooCommerce) adds its own separator inside it.
  • Fix: menu items without a page of their own, such as WooCommerce’s Payments and Products, now move along when you move their plugin to another tab.

0.6.0

  • First release.
